description: Check whether a configured host is up right now by opening one TCP connection to its check port (22 unless the profile sets another) and closing it; sends no Wake-on-LAN packet. Name the host by its alias from wol_list_hosts; its profile must include an address. The outcome is open (reachable), refused (the machine answered but nothing listens on that port), or no_answer (nothing answered within 1.5 seconds). Use it to re-check a host after wol_wake_host returns not_reachable or unverified.
name: wol_check_host

address.description: Address probed, as configured (hostname or IP).

check_port.description: TCP port probed: the profile's check_port.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_host`: The alias matches no configured profile. `no_address`: The profile has no address, so there is nothing to probe. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

guidance.description: Next step, present for refused and no_answer.

latency_ms.description: Connect start to answer, in ms; present for open and refused.

outcome.description: open: connected. refused: the machine answered but nothing listens on the port. no_answer: nothing answered within 1.5 s.

reachable.description: True only when the connection opened (outcome open).

title: Check Host
